plain: A rating scale where every point is pinned to a real example of behaviour at that level.
eli5: Instead of “1 to 5 stars”, each star comes with a picture of what that many stars looks like.
technical: Smith and Kendall (1963): critical incidents are collected, retranslated (experts re-sort unlabelled incidents into dimensions; those that do not return are dropped), scaled, and low-agreement incidents discarded; the survivors anchor each scale point.
